translations.web: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
translations.bsb: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.
translations.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
translations.asv: for neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
